objective: Detect a capital-independent cross-sectional momentum edge before execution design.
universe_policy: Fixed cohort for the complete test; no asset may be added or removed after performance is observed.
known_limitation: The cohort is selected from companies known to survive through 2024; a pass is research evidence, not proof free of survivorship bias.

data.source: Dukascopy M1 aggregated to NYSE RTH D1

common_rules.signal: total close-to-close return over lookback_sessions, observed at rebalance close
common_rules.absolute_filter: an asset is eligible only when its lookback return is positive
common_rules.ranking: descending lookback return with symbol alphabetical tie-break
common_rules.entry: next NYSE session open after the rebalance signal
common_rules.allocation: equal weight among selected assets; unallocated weight remains cash
common_rules.dividends: excluded from this price-only screen and must be added point-in-time before promotion
common_rules.costs: excluded from edge discovery; turnover and break-even cost are reported for the execution audit

statistical_gates.density: At least 3 of 12 variants pass, spanning at least two lookbacks and both top_n choices.
statistical_gates.benchmark_requirement: Passing variants must beat equal-weight buy-and-hold on either Sharpe or maximum drawdown in validation and OOS; raw return alone is insufficient.

prohibitions: No SQCLI genetic search for this portfolio-ranking layer.
